title: What to expect from Transfer and Bandwidth Limits

question.author: member_235
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for transfer and bandwidth limits?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: Desktop clients can throttle bandwidth per network in Settings > Network, which is useful on metered connections. Free plans include 200 GB per day of combined upload and download traffic. Paid plans have no daily cap, subject to fair-use limits. Downloads of shared links by anonymous visitors count against the link owner's transfer limit. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
